title: Sandra Bullock reveals her own UFO sighting on podcast
excerpt: The “Practical Magic 2” actress said she feels validated by recently released UFO files.
content:
Sandra Bullock speaks onstage at ELLE's 25th Annual Women In Hollywood Celebration presented by L'Oreal Paris, Hearts On Fire and CALVIN KLEIN at Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills on October 15, 2018. (Credit: Neilson Barnard/Getty Images for ELLE Magazine)

(NewsNation) — Actress Sandra Bullock revealed that she had a UFO sighting decades ago, saying she has felt validated by recent attention to the subject.

The “Practical Magic 2” actress told her story on Kylie Kelce’s “Not Gonna Lie” podcast, saying she believes there are alien ships flying in the sky.

Bullock, 62, said she was happy that the government has corroborated her story, referring to the release of declassified UAP files by the Pentagon.

She said she saw multiple UFOs flying over a coastal area while filming in Saint Martin, along with a bunch of people who went out to the beach after filming wrapped.

Bullock didn’t specify the project she was working on, but her 1997 film “Speed 2: Cruise Control” filmed some scenes in the Caribbean.

The actress described seeing a little point of light joined by others in the sky, until there were five lights all together. Then, she said, they just took off, saying that she didn’t believe the craft were from this world.

Bullock said her sighting matched those talked about in recently released files describing sightings from pilots.

The actress also said she doesn’t think aliens would be happy with Earth, suggesting they could be invisible and laughing at the planet.
